scope: All persistence stores that CAN hold Context-derived data, as of RV.2 HEAD e5d8b6e.
method: Static analysis: grep for context_id / contextId / session_id references across backend/app/, cross-referenced with ORM __tablename__ declarations in backend/app/models/ and backend/app/icoder/agent_runtime/context/db_models.py.

stores.name: conversation_memories
stores.evidence_pre: memory_expert.py:233-329 creates rows; hard_delete_context pre-RV.3 did not touch conversation_memories
stores.evidence_post: context_repository.py post-RV.3 — sa_delete ConversationMemory where session_id LIKE '{context_id}:%'

stores.name: run_history
stores.evidence_pre: agent_run.py:412 writes context_id on RunHistory row; pre-RV.3 hard_delete did not touch run_history
stores.evidence_post: context_repository.py post-RV.3 — redact input_text + output_summary + clear context_id where context_id = X (row kept for audit; content scrubbed)
stores.retention_note: Row itself is retained (per compliance audit trail); only PHI-bearing columns are redacted.

stores.name: run_trace_events
stores.evidence_pre: agent_run.py emits trace events containing context metadata; pre-RV.3 hard_delete did not touch run_trace_events
stores.evidence_post: context_repository.py post-RV.3 — redact safe_metadata_json where run_id IN (select run_id from run_history where context_id = X)

stores.name: mcp_temporary_auth_state
stores.link_to_context: Computed from context_messages row count for context_id; no separate table.
stores.evidence: thread_auth.py:43-54 — is_first_message() selects from ContextMessageRow; when messages are deleted, state resets to 'first message'.

stores.name: expert_invocations_metadata
stores.link_to_context: Via run_id -> run_history.context_id; also stored transiently in run_trace_events.safe_metadata_json
stores.evidence: Stored only as runtime metadata field inside run_trace_events.safe_metadata_json; redaction of that column (id=9) covers this.

stores.name: audit_logs
stores.link_to_context: resource_id MAY equal context_id for some audit events (e.g. agent_run logs context_id); details JSON MAY contain context_id
stores.evidence_pre: audit_detail_redactor.py already strips context_id from details; but rows with resource_id=context_id retained full content.
stores.evidence_post: context_repository.py post-RV.3 — redact details + model_input_summary + model_output_summary + tool_calls_made where resource_id = X (row retained, content scrubbed, redaction marker stamped).
stores.retention_note: Audit row retained for compliance; only PHI-bearing columns redacted. New audit row recording the delete event itself is written by destroy_now.

stores.name: conversation_memories.key_facts['_embedding']
stores.link_to_context: Inline in rows whose session_id starts with context_id
stores.evidence: memory_expert.py:311-321 stores embedding inline. Deleting the parent conversation_memories row (id=7) covers this.

stores.name: external_expert_fixture_cache
stores.link_to_context: No persistent store. Expert external calls are made via PubMedAdapter / ClinicalTrialsAdapter — responses are not persisted to DB.
stores.evidence: grep -rln 'fixture_cache|external_expert_cache|ExpertFixture' backend/app/ returns empty. VCR cassettes exist only under tests/fixtures/ for test replay, not runtime persistence.

stores.name: runtime_sessions
stores.link_to_context: legacy_tenancy_attribution.py:252 notes 'runtime_sessions does NOT have context_id today' — column is not present on runtime_sessions table.
stores.evidence: legacy_tenancy_attribution.py:251-260 — code path explicitly handles missing context_id column by returning early.

summary.real_gaps_vs_charter_section_7_2: 4 gaps (memory + run_history + run_trace + audit_logs) closed in RV.3. The other 11 stores were either already scrubbed (direct children + interview inline + mcp_auth derived) or proven N/A (external expert cache + runtime_sessions no context_id column + embedding-inline-via-memory).

marker_scan_strategy.insertion: Synthetic content with marker is inserted into every PHI-bearing store pre-delete via the test fixture.
marker_scan_strategy.scan_query: For each table, run a LIKE '%RV3MARKER-{context_id}-%' query across all TEXT/JSON columns post-delete. Expected count: 0.
marker_scan_strategy.false_positive_guard: Marker contains the unique context_id (UUID v4) so accidental collision with real data is cryptographically negligible.
